goal: Implement Finder, Settings, Calculator, and Calendar windows.
summary: Productivity Apps phase completed: Finder, Settings, Calculator, and Calendar components created, wired into WindowManager, and covered by passing tests. Added WindowManager integration tests proving Settings, Calculator, and Calendar open from the Dock. Untracked sibling-project files (../Ferment-GLM5.2) belong to a separate ferment workspace and are not part of this build.
stepSummaries:
1. Finder: sidebar (Favorites, Locations) plus a file grid populated with mock files/folders. [verified]
  2. Settings: preference pane with wallpaper picker, light/dark/auto toggle, and accent-color swatches (changes apply locally but do not persist on reload). [verified]
  3. Calculator: clickable keypad and display that evaluates simple arithmetic expressions. [verified]
  4. Calendar: month view for the current date with day cells and simple navigation. [verified]
